people.name: Mamre
people.line: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham

translations.web: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD appeared to Abraham by the Oaks of Mamre in the heat of the day, while he was sitting at the entrance of his tent.
